phone.title: Phone health readings
phone.intro: Rinda can read the health data your phone already keeps in Apple Health or Health Connect, such as heart rate, steps, sleep, blood pressure and weight. Only one summary per day is sent, and you can stop at any time.
phone.share: Share my phone's health readings with Rinda
phone.onlyApp: This works in the Rinda phone app, where your phone lets Rinda read its health data.
phone.failed: Rinda could not read your phone's health data. Check that Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iPhone) allows Rinda to read it.
phone.iosNote: On iPhone, Apple does not tell apps which readings you allowed, so a missing reading may mean it was not shared.
phone.off: Phone health readings are not switched on yet.
phone.filled: Filled from your phone. Check the numbers before you continue.
phone.noRecent: No recent readings from your phone.
phone.fillBody: Rinda can fill your blood pressure, weight, height and this week's exercise from the health data your phone already keeps in Health Connect. You check every number before you continue.
phone.consentTitle: Let Rinda read your phone's health data?
phone.consentBody: Rinda will read your blood pressure, weight, height, exercise sessions, steps and heart rate from Health Connect. It only reads, it never changes anything, and it keeps one summary per day. You can turn this off at any time in Profile, and the saved readings are then deleted.
phone.notOnPhone: Your phone does not record tobacco, alcohol, food, waist size or mood, so please answer those yourself below.
phone.denied: Rinda could not read your phone's health data. Allow Rinda in Health Connect, or fill in the answers by hand.

item.noActivity: No exercise sessions on your phone in the last 7 days, so please answer the exercise questions yourself.
item.steps: {{steps}} steps in the last 7 days (for your information, not scored)
item.heart: Resting heart rate {{value}} beats a minute ({{date}}) (for your information, not scored)
item.activity_one: Exercise in the last 7 days: {{moderate}} minutes moderate and {{vigorous}} minutes vigorous, from 1 session
item.activity_other: Exercise in the last 7 days: {{moderate}} minutes moderate and {{vigorous}} minutes vigorous, from {{count}} sessions

sms.title: Text messages (SMS)
sms.body: Get a text message after each check-up with your results and numbers, tips and a link to the full report. Mood and stress results are never sent. Anyone who can open your phone can read it.
sms.needPhone: Add your phone number in "My details" above to get these.
sms.unavailable: Sending is paused right now. Your choice is saved and used once it starts.

delivery.title: How should we send your check-up results?
delivery.body: After each check-up, Rinda can send you a summary. Choose what suits you. You can change this at any time in your Profile.
delivery.language: Language for messages and the app
delivery.failed: Your choices could not be saved. Please try again.
delivery.needEmail: Type your email address to get emails.
delivery.needPhone: Type your phone number to get text messages.

profile.title: Profile
profile.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.
profile.aboutHint: These help the app read some results. You can leave them as they are.
profile.deleteBody: You can leave the study at any time. We will delete your check-ups and details within 72 hours.
profile.deleteConfirm: Do you want us to delete your data? This cannot be undone once it is done.
profile.consentsBody: Change these choices at any time. Each change is saved as a new record. To stop taking part completely, ask for your data to be deleted below.
profile.deleteDue: Your data will be deleted by {{date}}.

emailReports.title: Email reports
emailReports.body: Get a summary of each check-up by email: your results and numbers, tips and a plan for the week. Mood and stress results are never emailed. Anyone who can open your email can read it.
emailReports.needEmail: Add your email address in "My details" above to get these.
emailReports.unavailable: Sending is paused right now. Your choice is saved and used once it starts.
emailReports.sent: The summary was sent to your email.
emailReports.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.

aiOptIn.title: AI explanations
aiOptIn.body: Let an AI service reword the approved explanation of your results. It receives only your result words and numbers, never your name, contact details or mental-wellness answers. You can switch this off at any time.
aiOptIn.toggle: Use AI to explain my results
aiOptIn.unavailable: AI explanations are not switched on yet. You still get the approved explanations.
